name: SPT Mod Manager
teaser: Open-source mod manager for SPT featuring easy installation, management and Forge integration.
description:
SPT Mod Manager

A mod manager built specifically for SPT.

I got tired of hunting down files one by one just to uninstall a mod, so I built a tool that solves that for good.

Features

  • Smart install. Handles .zip, .7z and .rar, and figures out on its own whether a mod is server, client or both, even when one archive ships several parts
  • Enable and disable without deleting. Turn a mod off to test something, turn it back on later. Prepatchers go along too, so a disabled mod is really disabled
  • Offline mod info. Reads name, author, version and target SPT version straight from the files, and flags anything that doesn’t match your install
  • Forge browser built in. Search the catalogue, pick a version and install with one click. Mods you already have show as installed
  • Dependency check. Finds missing dependencies before installing and offers to grab them, with sizes. If a shared library needs updating, it shows which installed mods use it
  • Bulk updates. Check every installed mod for updates at once and update from inside the app
  • Export and import mod lists. Share your setup with a friend or rebuild after a fresh SPT install with a single file. Missing mods get downloaded for you
  • Conflict detection. Catches two mods overwriting the same client file, or the same mod installed twice under different folder names
  • 7 languages. English, Portuguese, Chinese, Russian, French, Japanese and German

Installation

Download the .exe and run it. It installs everything and creates a desktop shortcut.

Windows will probably show a “Windows protected your PC” warning. That’s normal for unsigned indie software: click More info, then Run anyway.

Good to know

  • SPT core files are never touched. The Manager refuses to overwrite them, even if a mod archive ships its own copy
  • Archives only, for now. Installing from an extracted folder isn’t supported yet
  • Reinstalling asks for the archive again. Keeping a copy of every mod would double disk usage (a 3 GB mod would take 6 GB)
  • Built for the latest SPT. Older versions should work, but aren’t guaranteed
  • Windows only, for now. Linux support is planned

Support the project

SPT Mod Manager is free and always will be. If it saved you some headache, you can buy me a coffee. It helps me keep updating it!!
